title: The Talent Show
description: A shy boy performs magic tricks at his school talent show.
instructions: Read the text about a school talent show, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Every December, Greenhill School has a talent show. Students can sing, dance, play music or tell jokes on stage. This year, Omar wanted to do magic tricks. He practised every evening for a month in front of his little sister.

Omar was a very shy boy, and he did not like to speak in front of the class. On the day of the show, his hands were shaking. He looked out at the two hundred people in the hall. For a moment, he wanted to run away.
Then he saw his sister in the front row. She smiled and waved at him. Omar took a deep breath and started his first trick. He made a coin disappear and then found it behind the head teacher's ear.

Everyone laughed and clapped loudly. Omar did four more tricks, and they all worked perfectly. He did not win first prize, because a girl with a beautiful voice won. But after the show, many students came to ask him how he did his tricks.

The next Monday, Omar's teacher asked him to show a trick to the class. A month before, Omar was too shy to say anything in class. Now he stood at the front and made a card change colour in his hand. His classmates cheered, and his teacher laughed. Omar felt proud and much more confident.

After that, Omar started a magic club at school. It meets every Thursday after lessons in the library. At first, only three students came, but now there are fifteen members. Omar teaches them easy tricks with coins, cards and ropes. His little sister is the youngest member, and she always sits in the front row, like at the talent show.

Next December, Omar is going to be in the talent show again. This time, he is going to do his tricks with the whole magic club. They are practising a big trick with a box and a paper rabbit that disappears. Omar is still a little nervous before every show. But now he knows that being nervous is normal, and he does not want to run away any more.
